==Description==
'''Fireworks''', internally referred to as '''JulyFourth''', is a cosmetic [[Modifiers|modifier]] that adds Uncle Sam top hats onto every enemy and adds firework explosion particles when an enemy dies.

'''Fireworks''' is active on all maps on the Fourth of July and New Year's Day to celebrate Independence Day in the United States and New Year. It was first enabled on all maps on the 4th of July 2022.

==Effects==
When active, '''Fireworks''' modifier will add Uncle Sam top hats onto every enemy. Upon death, it will emit firework explosion particles. If an enemy has its death animation, the death effect will play after the enemy disappears entirely. It does not override any cosmetic modifiers. Death effects from other modifiers will play, along with the firework explosion, but the Uncle Sam top hat will be replaced by other modifiers' hats.

On some enemies like the [[Normal]], the Uncle Sam top hat may be much bigger than it should be.

==Trivia==
*This modifier shares its icon with the [[Birthday]] modifier.
*The Uncle Sam top hat added onto every enemy is the {{RLinkC|2711557|Uncle Sam's Top Hat}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
*Unlike other day modifiers, the '''Fireworks''' modifier lasts for two days after the Fourth of July.
